expectedResults: Capability notice is non-blocking and truthful, duration is accessible, and evidence clearly names the device, OS, route, selected tone, level, actions, outcome, and limitations.
notes: Do not use simulator outcomes as physical-audio qualification.
objective: Verify route capability disclosure, accessible duration, and the physical-device qualification boundaries for sustained iPhone reference-tone playback.
steps: Exercise built-in speaker, wired or USB, Bluetooth, and AirPlay where supported, including connection, removal, and replacement while playing.
Record duration, output capability disclosure, latency, two-hour endurance, memory, size, thermal, and energy observations using the approved physical-device matrix.
title: iPhone route capability, duration, and sustained-playback qualification
